A card with the '''grabber''' icon "grabs" cards and places them on itself; a card must have the icon to count as a grabber. A card stacked on a grabber is always supporting, even if it came from on table. Once a card is stacked on a grabber, that exact card may not be targeted by another grabber, although other copies of it can be. A card cannot be removed from a grabber unless a card says it can.<ref name="ar">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), Chapter 9, "Icons - Grabbers".</ref>

For example, when the Light Side plays [[Desperate Reach]] and the Dark Side responds with [[Tentacle]], the Interrupt is stacked on Tentacle, and the Light Side cannot target that copy of Desperate Reach with its own grabber.<ref name="ar" />

Errata added the grabber icon to [[A Tragedy Has Occurred]], [[Allegations Of Corruption]], [[Do They Have A Code Clearance?]], [[Grappling Hook]], [[Tentacle]], [[There'll Be Hell To Pay]] and [[What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?]].<ref name="ar" />
